_meta.coverage_metric: planted hollow-receipt, unsafe merge-rule target, forged/stale merge-admit, canonical-link divergence, wasteful CI publication, stale local verification, and untrusted GitHub snapshot detection
_meta.purpose: Prove that delivery receipts, repo-scoped Codex merge rules, merge-authority preflight, canonical linking, private-Actions publication, and its evidence producers fail closed without network access.

covers: complete receipt
missing artifact is failure rather than skip
runnable.expected: good PASS and hollow UNMATERIALIZED FAIL

covers: repository-scoped prefix rule
existing rule backup
unsafe repository rejection
PreToolUse and human-gate boundary warning
runnable.expected: good repo installs and checks allow; hollow target fails before Codex execution

covers: merge-admit label applied by a non-owner is refused
admit that predates the head commit is stale, not valid
nothing admitted exits 3, distinct from a layer refusing with 1
a PreToolUse hook that exits 2 refuses the run on the active host only
owner-auto lands through GraphQL pinned to expectedHeadOid and never sends authorEmail
owner identity is refused for a foreign owner, an organization, or a non-personal account
owner-auto exposes no --admin bypass
runnable.expected: good PREFLIGHT GREEN; hollow blocked at L1; empty exits 3; blocking hook exits 1; owner-auto admits only an immutable personal-User owner and its merge command carries expectedHeadOid without authorEmail

runnable.good_evidence: identical copy of the canonical skill in a scratch repo
runnable.hollow_mutations: same copy with a local edit appended to SKILL.md
covers: diverged copy is refused and left untouched, never moved aside
old copy is moved to a backup, never deleted
re-running on an already-linked target is an idempotent success
linking the canonical directory to itself is refused
runnable.expected: good converts and stays readable through the link; hollow exits non-zero naming the divergence

covers: local commit cadence is independent from remote CI publication cadence
exact local HEAD requires a passing local verification receipt
only initial draft PR, ready-for-review, and one batched repair are admitted
older-SHA CI success and repeated feedback fail closed
billing or spending-limit no-runner evidence opens a circuit breaker
only a later owner-authored recovery receipt can admit another attempt
a compact receipt cannot authorize publication unless the evidence its digest names is read and recomputed
runnable.expected: good initial publication ALLOW; hollow billing snapshot BLOCK; stale HEAD, repeated feedback, and stale recovery remain red; a perfect receipt paired with evidence from another run exits 64

runnable.hollow_mutations: dirty worktree, repository identity mismatch, shell string, unsafe inherited env, timeout, nonzero exit, or output overflow
covers: clean exact local HEAD and tree are recorded
commands are fixed argv arrays executed without a shell
environment inheritance is a safe-name allowlist
timeout and output budgets are enforced
receipt digest binds detailed command evidence
FAIL evidence cannot be consumed as PASS
runnable.expected: clean fixed-command contract emits PASS; dirty, stale, unsafe, timed-out, overflowing, or nonzero subjects turn red

covers: private repository identity and one PR are bound
stable check is selected by policy workflow identity, exact name, and exact head
actionable CI failure becomes one feedback identity
known payment or spending annotation becomes billing-open with no test conclusion
replay is zero-network
multiple PRs, public repositories, mismatched workflow paths, same-workflow reruns, stale checks, incomplete checks, and malformed annotations fail closed
runnable.expected: good observation produces a trusted snapshot; billing remains a circuit state; stale or ambiguous observations turn red

runnable.good_evidence: this repository's own .github-delivery/ci-policy.json against the workflow it names, so the seal is exercised where it is load-bearing rather than against a synthetic pair
runnable.hollow_mutations: a drifted schema, a public repository, a malformed repository slug, a workflow outside .github/workflows/, a workflow path that leaves the repository, an empty required-jobs list, a shell string where an argv array belongs, and a required job the workflow does not declare
covers: a policy that names a workflow is checked against the workflow on disk, not only against its own shape
a required job absent from the owning workflow fails closed
publication policy admits argv arrays, never shell strings
the seal is private-repository only
runnable.expected: this repository's policy passes; each planted field turns red with a reason naming that field

runnable.good_evidence: this skill's own SKILL.md against its own modules/ and scripts/ directories
runnable.hollow_mutations: a dead link appended to a copy of SKILL.md, and a file added to a copied modules/ that SKILL.md cannot name
covers: a link that resolves to nothing is refused
a file the index never names is refused, which is the half that is otherwise invisible
the checker's own --selftest runs first, so its verdict here means something
runnable.expected: green on this skill's tree; on first run it found eight files this SKILL.md never named, including scripts/delivery_sync.py
